findings.claim: FY2026 10-K：Apple 透過間接通路（電信商、經銷商）的淨銷售約占總淨銷售 60%，其餘經直營零售、線上商店與直銷團隊；一手文件未載明通路結構性轉變。
findings.excerpt: During 2026, the Company’s net sales through its indirect distribution channels accounted for approximately 60% of total net sales.

findings.claim: 報導稱 Apple 付費訂閱達 15 億，Services 營收 307 億美元但出現 2022 年以來首次季減，CFO 歸因於手遊、部分國家 App Store 商業模式變動與美國連結外部付款裁決。
findings.source: ithinkdiff: Apple Hits 1.5 Billion Paid Subscriptions as Services Growth Slows
findings.excerpt: Apple Hits 1.5 Billion Paid Subscriptions as Services Growth Slows by Imran HussainJul 31, 2026 Apple announced it has surpassed 1.5 billion paid subscriptions, disclosing the figure alongside its fiscal Q3 2026 earnings on July 30. Services revenue hit $30.7 billion for the quarter, but the segment also posted its first sequential decline since 2022.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 搜尋未找到權威媒體或 Apple 官方對通路結構性轉變的 2026 報導；僅見低可信部落格（企業業務客戶經理縮編、分拆發表時程傳聞），未納入。訂閱數 1.5B 與 Services 季減報導僅有搜尋摘要，列為 clue。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
